newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia wool indicator rises 12 cents to 687c/kg.
newsitem.headline: Australia wool indicator rises 12 cents to 687c/kg.

text.p: The Australian wool market eastern indicator rose 12 cents to 687 cents a kg clean on Tuesday at sales in Sydney and Melbourne, Wool International said.
Merino fleece was dearer, with 19/20 microns up one percent, 21/22m up 1.5 percent and 23/24/25/26m up two percent, while merino skirtings of 19/20/21m were up four percent and 22/23m up two percent.
In crossbreds, 27/28/29m were 1.5 percent dearer, 30m one percent dearer and 31m 0.5 percent dearer.

In cardings, lambs were fully firm with selected finer types keenly sought after, carbonising locks were up to five percent dearer, washing locks two percent dearer and crutchings up to one percent dearer.
WI said Japanese and Chinese interests were principal buyers with good support from most sectors of the trade.
Of the 25,277 bales offered, 5.2 percent were passed in.
Sales continue on Wednesday in Sydney, Melbourne and Fremantle with about 40,800 bales to be offered.
